mechanism: A single violent upward pulse on 2026-08-03 (+35% in one session) lifted the field off its July floor at 13.4, but in two and a half weeks since it has produced no further displacement, and a three-channel death cluster with a dead-channel URF=0.000 reading struck mid-plateau on 08-10. Into the final sessions the field spends unanimous upward displacement (08-14, 08-17) for zero price motion, then flips: the last three readings of 08-19 run negative displacement while close-of-session URF sags 0.53 to 0.38 and F_n tension climbs to 2.45 with price pinned at the pulse top. The pulse's stored energy is being distributed at the plateau while recovery fraction quietly drains — a spent pulse relaxing back toward the pre-spike floor.
